author: Kushal
problem: An integer k is 250-like if k = p * q^3 for primes p < q. Read N (up to 10^18) and print how many 250-like numbers are at most N.
bug_description: Sieves primes only up to 10^3 instead of 10^6, so for large N every pair whose q is above 1000 is missed.

comments.accurate: Counts numbers p * q^3 <= N with primes p < q, using a prime sieve and two pointers
comments.wrong_behavior: Counts numbers p * q^3 <= N with primes p < q, drawing p and q from the primes below 1000
comments.wrong_location: Sieve size verified; check the two-pointer loop's early exit when k meets i
